description: A signed roster mutation published to a channel's meta-queue (`<channel>:_meta`). Carries an add/remove/role-change operation, authored by an admin of the channel or the parent org. The substrate is uniform — everything is envelopes — so a roster update is also an envelope-body with `$type` set to this lexicon ID; this record describes the body shape. Like `tech.equanimi.secretariat.stamp`, the record carries its own ed25519 signature so a verifier can authenticate the mutation independent of envelope-level transport metadata. Roster state is derived by replaying ordered roster updates from `<channel>:_meta` (latest-wins per subject DID).

signer.description: DID of the admin authoring this roster mutation. Must match the verifying key the signature checks against AND must hold the `admin` role on the target channel (or be the channel owner's DID).

op.description: The mutation kind. `add` introduces a new member with the given roles. `remove` drops the subject from the roster. `role_change` replaces the subject's role set with the given roles (full replacement, not delta).

subject.description: DID of the member being added, removed, or changed.

channel.description: Canonical channel URI in the form `<owner-did>#<handle>` (e.g. `did:web:themia.pro#channel:dommage-corporel:paris-cohort`). Note: in `tech.equanimi.secretariat.envelope` the same address is carried as two factored fields `(to, handle)`; this record embeds the composite URI string because it travels as an envelope *body* and benefits from being self-describing for verifiers replaying roster history out of context. Parsers split on the first `#` — DID grammar forbids `#` inside the DID, so the split is unambiguous. The roster update applies to this channel; the meta-queue carrying this record is the channel's `<handle>:_meta` queue on the same owner.

roles.description: Roles being assigned to the subject. Required for `add` and `role_change`; ignored for `remove`. `subscribe` = receive envelopes; `publish` = send envelopes; `admin` = sign roster updates and channel-definition changes. Roles compose (a member can hold multiple).

effectiveAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp from which the mutation takes effect. Verifiers SHOULD reject mutations with `effectiveAt` in the future beyond a reasonable skew; replays are ordered by this field then by record TID.

note.description: Optional free-form note (e.g. `Christophe onboarded as view-only`). Not interpreted by the protocol.

signature.description: Detached ed25519 signature over the canonical bytes of (op, subject, channel, roles, effectiveAt). Format: `ed25519:<base64>` with 64 raw bytes. Canonicalization rule: concatenate the listed fields as UTF-8 strings separated by U+001F (unit separator), with `roles` joined by U+001E (record separator) in lexicographic order.
